candidates.statement: Synthetic mobile lab LCP is 5.2 seconds.
candidates.action: Investigate the measured loading timeline before choosing a fix.

candidates.statement: Synthetic first content appears slowly in the same recorded lab run.
candidates.action: Inspect the same loading timeline; group with c01 rather than create a second loading priority.

candidates.statement: Synthetic owner-confirmed phone value differs from the published business contact number.
candidates.action: Confirm the recorded owner approval remains current, then prepare an exact correction proposal.

candidates.statement: Synthetic verified history has one post in 90 days and 84 days since the latest post.
candidates.action: Plan a sustainable posting routine; do not predict commercial benefit.

candidates.statement: Synthetic human review confirms informative images with missing alternatives.
candidates.action: Prepare accurate alternatives after mapping exact saved image targets; do not use homepage findings as media IDs.

candidates.statement: Synthetic complete paired evidence records ten eligible inquiries with no business responses during the measured period.
candidates.action: Review unanswered inquiries and establish a response routine without guessing an expected response-time improvement.

candidates.statement: Synthetic saved sources disagree on business name; neither has established authority.
candidates.action: Ask the owner to confirm the intended name before any edit.

candidates.statement: Synthetic saved homepage HTML includes noindex; intended indexing status is unknown.
candidates.action: Confirm the intended indexing status before proposing any removal; make no ranking prediction.

expectedDecisionSpace: Select up to three distinct issue groups out of seven. Contact correctness and unanswered inquiries generally outrank cosmetic improvements. Loading versus indexing-intent review is a genuine conditional tradeoff; accept multiple defensible orders.
acceptableConstraints: At most one loading priority for c01/c02.
Never recommend automatic noindex removal without confirming intent.
Do not assume which source has the correct business name.
Use only supplied facts, citations and safe review actions.
A model tie with the strong deterministic baseline is a valid outcome.

mandatoryContext.statement: Synthetic audience is ten followers with two measured LIKE actions in the reporting period. This is not growth or unique engagement.

measurementGaps: Posting history inaccessible: inactivity is unproven.
Follower growth unavailable: weak growth is unproven.
Response-time pairs absent: slow customer responses are unproven.
Website performance measurement stale: current slow performance is unproven.
expected: Return one verification opportunity, not three padded recommendations. Missing measurements are caveats, never failures or scored zeros. Keep small-audience context even if not selected as a strength.
